chunks: And it is narrated from Abū Baṣīr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"Staying one day before hajj is better than staying two days after hajj."

key_terms.أَفْضَلُ: more virtuous or superior in merit
key_terms.مُقَامُ: staying or remaining in a place

ai.seo_question: Is staying before hajj more virtuous than staying after hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith states the greater merit of remaining before hajj compared to a longer stay after it. It highlights the special virtue and spiritual value of preparation and presence leading up to the rites of hajj.
